response.reason: The downsweep in _exclusive_chunks composes in reversed order: at each level the right child should receive compose(prefix, left_sum) (prefix applied first) but the code computes compose(left_sum, prefix). For C=4 (N in 25..32, chunks=4) the exclusive carry for the last chunk becomes v2∘(v0∘v1) instead of (v0∘v1)∘v2, which is wrong whenever the affine chunk summaries do not commute.
